ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_000
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 今天我是有话要说才来的

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_001
ui_voice_tap#2.text: ……我要退出CRYCHIC

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_002
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 不……是我个人的问题

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_003
ui_voice_tap#2.text: ……我没说

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_005
ui_voice_tap#2.text: ……就算没有我，大家也可以练习吧？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_006
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
没有规定人不齐就不能练。
不要把责任推到我身上

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_007
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
别说那种幼稚的话了，
灯明明是最需要练习的那个，
但至今为止你都做了什么？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_009
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
……？
你是吹奏乐社的吗？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_010
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
……！
……为什么突然这么说……

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_011
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
……不。抱歉。
我无法满足你的要求

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_013
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 为什么擅自到羽丘来了？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_014
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
我应该说过，
我的事情不要告诉任何人吧？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_015
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 你做了那么显眼的事情，就跟说了一样

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_016
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 能麻烦你跟她说，我已经搬家了吗？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_017
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 唉……睦做不出这种事呢

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_018
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
我要走了。
睦，你可不能当传话筒哦。
再见

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_019
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
好，要开始拍了。
大家准备好了吗？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_020
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
睦，再往左一点。
你得有要站在正中间的念头才行

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_021
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
灯，你不用想着唱好。
只要表达出自己的感情就可以了

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_022
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 好痛……没事吧？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_023
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
突然把你推开，我很抱歉……
但是，不要寻死啊！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_024
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
你刚才是想从桥上跳下去吧！？
你在想什么！？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_026
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 花和命，到底哪个重要！？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_027
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
啊，不……
花也是有生命的吧……

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_029
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
……是我弄错了。
原来你没有想不开啊……

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_030
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
……？啊，糟糕了……
好像是把你推开的时候擦伤了

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_031
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
没事。这点小伤没关系的。
那么，再见

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_033
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
明明是我误会了，
你还帮我处理伤口……总觉得很过意不去呢

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_034
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
话说回来，你的房间真可爱呢。
有好多漂亮的罐子和盒子……

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_035
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 啊，这个笔记本……

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_036
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
好怀念呢。
小时候，我也用过

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_037
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
因为封面有珍稀的动植物照片，
我以前非常中意

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_038
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
哎呀，这么多，真亏你收集得到呢。
我经常用独角仙封面的……

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_039
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
不、不劳烦了……
这本香豌豆封面的我也用过。
我记得它格子很大，用起来很方便……

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_041
ui_voice_tap#2.text: ……这些文字，是你写的吗？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_042
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
虽然像大家一样交到了朋友，
但和大家在一起，却觉得很孤独——

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_043
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 简直像歌词一样呢

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_044
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
这些笔记本都是吗……？
……真棒呢！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_045
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
我还没做自我介绍。
我叫丰川祥子

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_046
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 你叫什么？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_047
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
灯同学……
我有一个请求

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_048
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 要不要和我组乐队？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_049
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
那么，灯同学。
我来给你介绍大家

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_050
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
爽世同学是贝斯手。
她在月之森吹奏乐社担任低音大提琴手

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_051
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
在前段时间的月之森音乐节上
她的演奏非常精彩，
所以我就去找了她，请她一定要加入我们乐队

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_052
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
这位是睦。
她从小就热衷弹吉他，
很值得信赖哦

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_053
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
你又这样……
要更自信一点才行哦

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_054
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
睦是我的发小。
爽世同学和我同年级……

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_055
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 还有一个人是鼓手，也是第一次见

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_056
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
我和立希同学的姐姐以前就一直关系很好。
这次也是因此才和她联系上的

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_057
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
立希同学的姐姐是羽丘吹奏乐社的社长，
个人也在比赛中取得了优秀的成绩，是很优秀的演奏者哦。
最近她还参加了地区的管弦乐队，听说在里面很是活跃

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_058
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 不好意思。言归正传

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_059
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
咳咳……再次感谢各位
今天能聚集在这里

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_060
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 我一直很期待和大家见面

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_061
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
今后，我们就是乐队了……
我们会成为一起演奏音乐的命运共同体

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_062
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 嗯，很棒吧？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_063
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
好问题。
大家知道一支叫Morfonica的乐队吗？
是月之森的学姐们组成的乐队……

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_064
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
嗯，我也在那次音乐节上，
听了Morfonica的合奏

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_065
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
我感受到了优雅中隐藏着的强大的力量，
最重要的是，感受到了她们组乐队的快乐……
这让我深受感动

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_066
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
所以，我希望
能够演奏Morfonica的乐曲……

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_067
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
也希望将来，我们能合奏
属于我们自己的歌曲

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_068
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
不，一点都不高。
到时候由我来作曲……

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_069
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 而且重要的是，这位灯同学，是个作词天才

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_070
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 灯同学，能给大家看看那个笔记本吗？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_071
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
灯同学家里，
有好多写了歌词的笔记本

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_072
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
至于曲子，我曾经用钢琴弹过，
找时间在录音棚弹给你们听

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_073
ui_voice_tap#2.text: ……灯同学，你可是主唱哦？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_074
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
……灯同学，不用太失落。
今天是第一次，失败是在所难免的

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_075
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
你只是不习惯在别人面前唱歌而已。
只要多练习几次，肯定就……

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_077
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
……那首歌的歌词，是你写的。
肯定是你来演唱最合适

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_078
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 因为灯同学的歌词，是发自内心的呐喊

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_079
ui_voice_tap#2.text: ……我想要！成为人类——！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_080
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
汽车的声音这么响。
我的声音不会有人听到的

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_081
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
在这座天桥上可以尽情呐喊哦。
来，灯同学也一起喊吧！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_082
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 灯！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_083
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
只要想做，你就能做到嘛……！
就要这种气势！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_084
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
没关系，肯定会有好办法的！
下次练习的时候，和大家商量一下吧！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_085
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
我已经久闻这里的大名了……
有这样能自由地唱喜欢的歌的房间，真是太棒了呢

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_086
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 或许在家里做一个也不错呢

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_087
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 嗯，我觉得这是一个很棒的主意

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_088
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
我是第一次来卡拉OK店，
在这里的话，灯也能开心练习了吧？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_089
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
啊，那个我也很惊讶！
只要按一下按钮，居然就会有饮料出来……！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_090
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
而且还有很多种类呢。
灯选了哪个？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_091
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 那就要快点尝尝味道才行！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_092
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
房间的灯光不停变换……
甚至还有灯球呢！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_093
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 哎呀！灯光开始闪烁了！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_094
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
咦？声音没了哦。
不是轮到我了吗？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_095
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
不用在意。
来，轮到灯唱了哦

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_096
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 你的歌声很好听呢，灯！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_097
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
那么，接下来轮到我了呢！
我会尽全力唱的！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_098
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
……呼！
我的歌声怎么样！

ui_voice_tap#2.text:

ui_voice_tap#2.text:

ui_voice_tap#2.text:

ui_voice_tap#2.text:

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_113
ui_voice_tap#2.text:

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_114
ui_voice_tap#2.text: ……我们以后一定要再办演出啊！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_115
ui_voice_tap#2.text:

ui_voice_tap#2.text:

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_121
ui_voice_tap#2.text:

ui_voice_tap#2.text:

ui_voice_tap#2.text:

ui_voice_tap#2.text:

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_126
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 这是在讽刺我吗……？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_127
ui_voice_tap#2.text:

ui_voice_tap#2.text: 看来有必要和她谈一谈呢……

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_129

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_130

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_145

ui_voice_tap#2.text: 那么，你现在的乐队又算什么？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_147
ui_voice_tap#2.text:

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_148
ui_voice_tap#2.text:

ui_voice_tap#2.text: 睦。是这样吗？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_151
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 所以，我才亲手结束了它

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_152

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_153
ui_voice_tap#2.text:

ui_voice_tap#2.text: 你是抱着多大的决心说这句话的？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_156
ui_voice_tap#2.text:

ui_voice_tap#2.text:

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_159
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 你一心只为自己考虑呢

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_160
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 长崎爽世同学？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_161
ui_voice_tap#2.text:

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_163
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 不必了，没关系

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_164
ui_voice_tap#2.text: ——祝你幸福
